description: Take only the turn-reduction edits of the #1197 candidate into .agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md, and measure them on the held-out split under the #1197 decision rule.

userStories.title: Add the turn-reduction edits to /prd
userStories.description: As a /prd user, I want fewer tool turns for each plan so that each plan costs less.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/prd/SKILL.md` holds only group 1 edits from `.agro/evals/experiments/prd-efficiency/runs/optimize/candidates/cand-3.SKILL.md`: parallel setup reads, batched grounding calls, one call that writes and verifies the plan, one fix call for all checker findings, and no second read of a file.
The file holds no group 2 edit (a story cap, a Summary word cap, a story description word cap) and no group 3 edit (backtick rules, the `UNTRACKED` path loop, the task-folder rule).
The PR body maps each edit of candidate 3 to group 1, 2, or 3, and to included or excluded.
`.agro/evals/decisions/skill-impact.md` holds a new `PROPOSED` record for the change.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: git diff of SKILL.md holds the Cost budget section, the batched grounding bullets in section 3, and the single write-verify call and single fix call in section 6. 2 executed: grep for UNTRACKED, word caps, story caps, evidence.md, and ls-files finds 0 lines. 3 reasoned: the worker produced a 35-row mapping; the advisor puts it in the PR body. 4 executed: ste-check.sh on SKILL.md exit 0. 5 executed: link-providers.sh --check exit 0; git diff --check prints nothing. 6 executed: SI-0024 PROPOSED appended; wiki-skill-impact-append-only.sh and prd-output-path-contract.sh exit 0.

userStories.title: Measure the change on the held-out split
userStories.description: As the operator, I want a paired held-out measurement so that the change lands only on evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: `runs/heldout-1211/` of the `prd-efficiency` experiment holds 72 scored records: 12 held-out cases, 3 repeats, the baseline arm and the candidate arm at the US-001 commit.
The first episode costs $3.00 or less, and the run costs $70 or less.
`summarize.sh heldout-1211 --paired` reports each condition of the #1197 decision rule.
`results-1211.md` states the verdict, the metrics for each arm, and that the held-out split had one earlier evaluation in #1197.
If the verdict is not `success`, the branch reverts the `SKILL.md` change and keeps the evidence.
A comment on issue #1211 reports the verdict and the cost.
userStories.notes: 1 executed: summarize.sh heldout-1211 --paired; 72 scored records, 12 cases x 3 repeats x 2 arms, 0 excluded, candidate at 8fcbf890. 2 executed: the first episode cost $1.02; the run cost $54.30 of $70. 3 executed: summary.json paired.decision reports ratio_le_max true, upper_lt_max true, pass_rate_guard true, no_new_failure_class false (g1_paths on 1068), substance_guard true, verdict no-improvement. 4 executed: results-1211.md states the verdict, both arms, and the earlier #1197 evaluation; ste-check.sh exit 0. 5 executed: git diff --stat origin/development -- .agro/skills/prd/ prints nothing after the revert; SI-0024 stays in the append-only ledger. 6 executed: gh issue comment 1211, comment 5851382466.
